sentences.text: The top of the skull roof features grooves forming a truncated "Y" shape that separate three polygonal areas of bone tissue.
A complex network of vascular canals allowed the animal to redistribute blood flow to cool its brain and maintain optimal temperatures.
The length of the cochlear ducts suggests it was adapted for low-frequency hearing between 100 Hz and 3000 Hz.
The holotype braincase was excavated in September 1998 by a joint Uzbek-Russian-British-American project.
Jolyon Parish and Paul Barrett renamed the genus from Amtosaurus to Bissektipelta in 2004 after determining the original genus was a nomen dubium.
Victoria M. Arbour and Philip J. Currie affirmed that Bissektipelta belongs within the family Ankylosauridae.
The holotype specimen was collected from the Bissekty Formation at Dzharakuduk, dating to the late Turonian-Coniacian.
Bissektipelta lived during the Turonian stage, approximately 93.9 to 89.8 million years ago.
